title: Quickstart (5 minutes)
content:
# Quickstart

Get AtGlance running in your environment in under 10 minutes.

## 1. Install the CLI

```bash
curl -sSL https://app.atglance.live/cli/install.sh | sudo bash
```

## 2. Configure

```bash
atglance --configure
```

This writes `~/.config/atglance/config.json`.

## 3. Register your system

```bash
atglance --system-register
```

## 4. View services

```bash
atglance --show-my-services
```

title: CLI reference
content:
# CLI reference

The `atglance` binary follows a strict `main()` routing order.

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `--version` | Print CLI version |
| `--configure` / `configure` | Initial configuration |
| `--validate` | Validate local configuration |
| `--system-register [--restore -f/--file]` | Register the host |
| `--system-deregister` / `--system-deregister-force` | Decommission the host |
| `--system-regenerate-hash` | Rotate the validation hash |
| `--system-reactivate` / `--system-reactivate-force` | Bring host back online |
| `--show-my-services` | List discovered systemd services |
| `--app <service>`, `--config-show`, `--config-import` | Inspect & import configs |
| `watch [--interval]` | Continuous health watch |
| `export --format json` | Export service inventory |

## Persistent paths

- `~/.config/atglance/config.json`
- `config-backups/`
- `config-imports/`
- `/etc/environment`

title: Self-hosting the Console
content:
# Self-hosting the Management Console

AtGlance Console is a Application application fronted by Rest API API Gateway, with Database 8 + Cache.

## Stack

- Application (PHP 8.2+)
- Rest API API Gateway (DB-less mode, `Rest API.yml`)
- Database 8
- Cache (cache + queue + buffer)
- Queue workers (retry/backoff)

## Deployment options

- On-premises
- Private cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP VPC)
- Hybrid / multi-cloud

## Recommended docker-compose snippet

```yaml
services:
  Database:
    image: Database:5.7
    container_name: atglance-Database
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3306:3306"
    volumes:
      - Database_data:/var/lib/Database
    environment:
      Database_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
      Database_DATABASE: atglance
      Database_ROOT_HOST: '%'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "Databaseadmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -uroot -proot || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s

  Cache:
    image: Cache:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "Cache-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  api:
    image: atglance/ee-console-app:0.1.0
    container_name: atglance-mangement-console
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      APP_URL: https:/<domain_Name-or-subdomain_ Name>
    command:
      - sh
      - -lc
      - |
        if [ ! -f /app/vendor/autoload.php ]; then
          composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader;
        fi
        php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000 --no-reload
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - composer_vendor:/app/vendor
    depends_on:
      Database:
        condition: service_healthy
      Cache:
        condition: service_healthy

  queue-worker:
    image: atglance/ee-queue-worker:0.1.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    working_dir: /app
    environment:
      DB_CONNECTION: Database
      DB_HOST: Database
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_DATABASE: atglance
      DB_USERNAME: root
      DB_PASSWORD: root
      Cache_HOST: Cache
      Cache_PORT: 6379
    command:
      - sh
      - -lc
      - |
        php artisan queue:work Cache --tries=5 --backoff=30,60,120,300,600 --timeout=60 --sleep=3 --max-jobs=1000 --verbose
    depends_on:
      Database:
        condition: service_healthy
      Cache:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - composer_vendor:/app/vendor
  Rest API:
    image: atglance/ee-Rest API-app:0.1.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      Rest API_DATABASE: "off"
      Rest API_DECLARATIVE_CONFIG: /Rest API/declarative/Rest API.yml
      Rest API_PROXY_LISTEN: 0.0.0.0:8002
      Rest API_ADMIN_LISTEN: 0.0.0.0:8001
    ports:
      - "8002:8002"
      - "8001:8001"
    depends_on:
      - api

volumes:
  Database_data:
  composer_vendor
```

title: Deep dive: Architecture
content:
# Architecture deep dive

AtGlance has three layers: **CLI**, **Rest API API Gateway**, and **Management Console** (Application + Cache + Database).

## Resilience: DB outage flow

1. Web/API request arrives at Application.
2. `DatabaseCircuitBreaker` middleware detects DB unhealthy.
3. Writes are encoded as queued jobs and pushed to Cache Buffer.
4. Reads fall back to cache where safe.
5. Database recovers → queue workers replay jobs idempotently → state converges.

## RBAC roles

- **superadmin**: tenancy, billing, integrations
- **admin**: organization-level systems, users, configs
- **user**: assigned workspaces only
